title: Probability of a specified Boolean function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and choose uniformly from all Boolean functions on $n$ Boolean inputs. For any specified such function $g$, the probability that the chosen function equals $g$ at every input is $2^{-2^n}$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a Boolean function on $n$ Boolean inputs
